name: Ribbon Twist
description: The picture twists like a ribbon around its center line, the twist travelling across it, the first clip on the front and the second on the back. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: spread
params.description: Length of the twisted section, as a part of the frame

params.name: shading
params.description: How much the ribbon darkens as it turns

params.name: vertical
params.description: Twist around the vertical center line, travelling from top to bottom

params.name: back_color
params.description: Color where the ribbon leaves the frame uncovered
